fish.top: In the beginning God created
fish.bot: the heaven and the earth.
fish.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

fish.top: And Enoch walked with God:
fish.bot: and he was not; for God took him.
fish.verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

fish.top: I do set my bow in the cloud,
fish.bot: and it shall be for a token of a covenant...
fish.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

fish.top: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield,
fish.bot: and thy exceeding great reward.
fish.verse: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

fish.top: I am the Almighty God;
fish.bot: walk before me, and be thou perfect.
fish.verse: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

fish.top: And the LORD visited Sarah
fish.bot: as he had said...
fish.verse: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

fish.top: My son, God will provide
fish.bot: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...
fish.verse: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

fish.top: I being in the way,
fish.bot: the LORD led me...
fish.verse: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

fish.top: And, behold, I am with thee,
fish.bot: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...
fish.verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

fish.top: I will not let thee go,
fish.bot: except thou bless me.
fish.verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

fish.top: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered
fish.bot: him out of their hands...
fish.verse: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

fish.top: And the LORD was with Joseph,
fish.bot: and he was a prosperous man...
fish.verse: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

fish.top: ...for God did send me
fish.bot: before you to preserve life.
fish.verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

fish.top: Moreover he kissed all his brethren,
fish.bot: and wept upon them...
fish.verse: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

fish.top: Ye thought evil against me;
fish.bot: but God meant it unto good...
fish.verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

fish.top: And I am come down to deliver them
fish.bot: out of the hand of the Egyptians...
fish.verse: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

fish.top: And I will take you to me for a people,
fish.bot: and I will be to you a God...
fish.verse: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

fish.top: ...that my name may be declared
fish.bot: throughout all the earth.
fish.verse: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

fish.top: The LORD is my strength and song,
fish.bot: and he is become my salvation...
fish.verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

fish.top: ...how I bare you on eagles' wings,
fish.bot: and brought you unto myself.
fish.verse: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

fish.top: ...ye shall be a peculiar treasure
fish.bot: unto me above all people...
fish.verse: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

fish.top: Behold, I send an Angel before thee,
fish.bot: to keep thee in the way...
fish.verse: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

fish.top: And there I will meet with thee,
fish.bot: and I will commune with thee...
fish.verse: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

fish.top: And they shall know
fish.bot: that I am the LORD their God...
fish.verse: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

fish.top: My presence shall go with thee,
fish.bot: and I will give thee rest.
fish.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest.

fish.top: ...every one whom his spirit made willing,
fish.bot: and they brought the LORD's offering...
fish.verse: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

fish.top: Then a cloud covered the tent...
fish.bot: and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
fish.verse: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

fish.top: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle
fish.bot: by day, and fire was on it by night...
fish.verse: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

fish.top: ...the priest shall make an atonement for him,
fish.bot: and it shall be forgiven him.
fish.verse: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

fish.top: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar;
fish.bot: it shall never go out.
fish.verse: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

fish.top: For I am the LORD your God...
fish.bot: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...
fish.verse: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

fish.top: ...to cleanse you, that ye may be clean
fish.bot: from all your sins before the LORD.
fish.verse: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

fish.top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
fish.bot: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
fish.verse: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

fish.top: ...the seventh day is the sabbath of rest,
fish.bot: an holy convocation...
fish.verse: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

fish.top: ...thou shalt leave them unto the poor,
fish.bot: and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
fish.verse: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

fish.top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
fish.bot: unto all the inhabitants thereof...
fish.verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

fish.top: The LORD bless thee,
fish.bot: and keep thee.
fish.verse: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

fish.top: ...and he shall recompense his trespass
fish.bot: with the principal thereof...
fish.verse: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

fish.top: Now the man Moses was very meek,
fish.bot: above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.
fish.verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

fish.top: Let us go up at once, and possess it;
fish.bot: for we are well able to overcome it.
fish.verse: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

fish.top: ...the rod of Aaron...
fish.bot: was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms...
fish.verse: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

fish.top: ...I am thy part and thine inheritance
fish.bot: among the children of Israel.
fish.verse: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

fish.top: ...every one that is bitten,
fish.bot: when he looketh upon it, shall live.
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

fish.top: ...that the congregation of the LORD
fish.bot: be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
fish.verse: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

fish.top: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD...
fish.bot: he shall not break his word...
fish.verse: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

fish.top: ...cities of refuge for you;
fish.bot: that the slayer may flee thither...
fish.verse: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

fish.top: ...the LORD thy God bare thee,
fish.bot: as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went...
fish.verse: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

fish.top: Hear, O Israel:
fish.bot: The LORD our God is one LORD:
fish.verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD :

fish.top: And thou shalt teach them diligently
fish.bot: unto thy children...
fish.verse: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

fish.top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
fish.bot: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...
fish.verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

fish.top: Thou shalt open thine hand wide
fish.bot: unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy...
fish.verse: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

fish.top: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet
fish.bot: ...unto him ye shall hearken;
fish.verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

fish.top: ...thou shalt surely help him
fish.bot: to lift them up again.
fish.verse: Thou shalt not see thy brother’s ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.

fish.top: And when we cried unto the LORD...
fish.bot: the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction...
fish.verse: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

fish.top: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God:
fish.bot: but those things which are revealed belong unto us...
fish.verse: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

fish.top: ...that thou mayest obey his voice,
fish.bot: and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life...
fish.verse: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

fish.top: The eternal God is thy refuge,
fish.bot: and underneath are the everlasting arms...
fish.verse: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them .

fish.top: Be strong and of a good courage;
fish.bot: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
fish.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

fish.top: Joshua said unto the people, Shout;
fish.bot: for the LORD hath given you the city.
fish.verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

fish.top: ...the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man:
fish.bot: for the LORD fought for Israel.
fish.verse: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

fish.top: Now therefore give me this mountain...
fish.bot: if so be the LORD will be with me...
fish.verse: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

fish.top: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land,
fish.bot: which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
fish.verse: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

fish.top: But the mountain shall be thine;
fish.bot: ...for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites...
fish.verse: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

fish.top: ...and they shall be your refuge
fish.bot: from the avenger of blood.
fish.verse: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

fish.top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
fish.bot: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
fish.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD , choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD .

fish.top: ...The LORD is with thee,
fish.bot: thou mighty man of valour.
fish.verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

fish.top: I will not rule over you...
fish.bot: the LORD shall rule over you.
fish.verse: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

fish.top: O my Lord... come again unto us,
fish.bot: and teach us what we shall do...
fish.verse: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

fish.top: ...and when he had drunk,
fish.bot: his spirit came again, and he revived...
fish.verse: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

fish.top: O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee,
fish.bot: and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once...
fish.verse: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

fish.top: ...whither thou goest, I will go;
fish.bot: ...thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
fish.verse: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

fish.top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
fish.bot: ...And he said, I will redeem it.
fish.verse: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it .

fish.top: Then Samuel answered,
fish.bot: Speak; for thy servant heareth.
fish.verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

fish.top: ...and called the name of it Eben-ezer,
fish.bot: saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
fish.verse: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

fish.top: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth...
fish.bot: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
fish.verse: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

fish.top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
fish.bot: but the LORD looketh on the heart.
fish.verse: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

fish.top: ...Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice,
fish.bot: and to hearken than the fat of rams.
fish.verse: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD ? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

fish.top: ...for the battle is the LORD’s,
fish.bot: and he will give you into our hands.
fish.verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s , and he will give you into our hands.

fish.top: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose,
fish.bot: and went to David... and strengthened his hand in God.
fish.verse: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

fish.top: ...I will not put forth mine hand
fish.bot: against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.
fish.verse: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.

fish.top: ...thou shalt surely overtake them,
fish.bot: and without fail recover all.
fish.verse: And David enquired at the LORD , saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

fish.top: And now the LORD shew kindness
fish.bot: and truth unto you...
fish.verse: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

fish.top: And thine house and thy kingdom
fish.bot: shall be established for ever before thee...
fish.verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

fish.top: And David danced before the LORD
fish.bot: with all his might...
fish.verse: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

fish.top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
fish.bot: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
fish.verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

fish.top: I have sinned against the LORD.
fish.bot: ...hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
fish.verse: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD . And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

fish.top: ...O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom!
fish.bot: would God I had died for thee...
fish.verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

fish.top: ...The LORD is my rock,
fish.bot: and my fortress, and my deliverer;
fish.verse: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

fish.top: ...neither will I offer burnt offerings
fish.bot: unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing.
fish.verse: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

fish.top: Give therefore thy servant
fish.bot: an understanding heart...
fish.verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

fish.top: ...I purpose to build an house
fish.bot: unto the name of the LORD my God...
fish.verse: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

fish.top: ...there hath not failed one word
fish.bot: of all his good promise...
fish.verse: Blessed be the LORD , that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

fish.top: If thou wilt be a servant unto this people...
fish.bot: then they will be thy servants for ever.
fish.verse: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

fish.top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
fish.bot: and consumed the burnt sacrifice...
fish.verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

fish.top: ...and after the fire
fish.bot: a still small voice.
fish.verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

fish.top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
fish.bot: of thy spirit be upon me.
fish.verse: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

fish.top: ...There is not a vessel more.
fish.bot: And the oil stayed.
fish.verse: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

fish.top: ...LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes,
fish.bot: that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes...
fish.verse: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD , I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

fish.top: And Jehoiada made a covenant...
fish.bot: that they should be the LORD’s people...
fish.verse: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

fish.top: And the LORD was gracious unto them,
fish.bot: and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them...
fish.verse: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

fish.top: For he clave to the LORD,
fish.bot: and departed not from following him...
fish.verse: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

fish.top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
fish.bot: behold, I will heal thee...
fish.verse: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD .

fish.top: ...did lift up the head of Jehoiachin
fish.bot: king of Judah out of prison;
fish.verse: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

fish.top: ...Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed,
fish.bot: and enlarge my coast... that thine hand might be with me...
fish.verse: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

fish.top: ...for they cried to God in the battle,
fish.bot: ...because they put their trust in him.
fish.verse: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

fish.top: ...David set over the service of song
fish.bot: in the house of the LORD...
fish.verse: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

fish.top: ...men that had understanding of the times,
fish.bot: to know what Israel ought to do...
fish.verse: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

fish.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
fish.bot: for his mercy endureth for ever.
fish.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

fish.top: ...Thus the LORD preserved David
fish.bot: whithersoever he went.
fish.verse: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

fish.top: And to stand every morning
fish.bot: to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
fish.verse: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

fish.top: ...know thou the God of thy father,
fish.bot: and serve him with a perfect heart...
fish.verse: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

fish.top: ...he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee,
fish.bot: until thou hast finished all the work...
fish.verse: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD .

fish.top: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power,
fish.bot: and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty...
fish.verse: Thine, O LORD , is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD , and thou art exalted as head above all.

fish.top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
fish.bot: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.
fish.verse: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

fish.top: ...because thy God loved Israel,
fish.bot: ...to do judgment and justice.
fish.verse: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

fish.top: ...for we rest on thee,
fish.bot: and in thy name we go against this multitude...
fish.verse: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD , it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD , thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

fish.top: ...let not your hands be weak:
fish.bot: for your work shall be rewarded.
fish.verse: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

fish.top: ...neither know we what to do:
fish.bot: but our eyes are upon thee.
fish.verse: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

fish.top: ...that should praise the beauty of holiness,
fish.bot: ...Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
fish.verse: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD , and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD ; for his mercy endureth for ever.

fish.top: ...as long as he sought the LORD,
fish.bot: God made him to prosper.
fish.verse: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

fish.top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
fish.bot: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
fish.verse: For if ye turn again unto the LORD , your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

fish.top: ...but with us is the LORD our God
fish.bot: to help us, and to fight our battles...
fish.verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

fish.top: ...all them whose spirit God had raised,
fish.bot: to go up to build the house of the LORD...
fish.verse: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...all the people shouted with a great shout,
fish.bot: when they praised the LORD...
fish.verse: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

fish.top: For Ezra had prepared his heart
fish.bot: to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it...
fish.verse: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

fish.top: So we fasted and besought our God for this:
fish.bot: and he was intreated of us.
fish.verse: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

fish.top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
fish.bot: therefore we his servants will arise and build...
fish.verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...resort ye thither unto us:
fish.bot: our God shall fight for us.
fish.verse: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

fish.top: ...neither be ye sorry;
fish.bot: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
fish.verse: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

fish.top: ...howbeit our God turned
fish.bot: the curse into a blessing.
fish.verse: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

fish.top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
fish.bot: for such a time as this?
fish.verse: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

fish.top: ...she obtained favour in his sight:
fish.bot: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre...
fish.verse: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

fish.top: The Jews had light,
fish.bot: and gladness, and joy, and honour.
fish.verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

fish.top: ...the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away;
fish.bot: blessed be the name of the LORD.
fish.verse: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

fish.top: I would seek unto God,
fish.bot: and unto God would I commit my cause...
fish.verse: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

fish.top: Though thy beginning was small,
fish.bot: yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
fish.verse: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

fish.top: With him is wisdom and strength,
fish.bot: he hath counsel and understanding.
fish.verse: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

fish.top: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven,
fish.bot: and my record is on high.
fish.verse: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

fish.top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
fish.bot: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.
fish.verse: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

fish.top: Whom I shall see for myself,
fish.bot: and mine eyes shall behold, and not another...
fish.verse: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

fish.top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
fish.bot: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
fish.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

fish.top: ...Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom;
fish.bot: and to depart from evil is understanding.
fish.verse: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

fish.top: Deliver him from going down to the pit:
fish.bot: I have found a ransom.
fish.verse: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

fish.top: If they obey and serve him,
fish.bot: they shall spend their days in prosperity...
fish.verse: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

fish.top: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still,
fish.bot: and consider the wondrous works of God.
fish.verse: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

fish.top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
fish.bot: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
fish.verse: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

fish.top: And he shall be like a tree
fish.bot: planted by the rivers of water...
fish.verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

fish.top: But thou, O LORD,
fish.bot: art a shield for me; my glory...
fish.verse: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

fish.top: And they that know thy name
fish.bot: will put their trust in thee...
fish.verse: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

fish.top: The words of the LORD are pure words:
fish.bot: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
fish.verse: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

fish.top: Thou wilt shew me the path of life:
fish.bot: in thy presence is fulness of joy...
fish.verse: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

fish.top: The heavens declare the glory of God;
fish.bot: and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
fish.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

fish.top: The LORD is my shepherd;
fish.bot: I shall not want.
fish.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

fish.top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
fish.bot: whom shall I fear?
fish.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

fish.top: Shew me thy ways, O LORD;
fish.bot: teach me thy paths.
fish.verse: Shew me thy ways, O LORD ; teach me thy paths.

fish.top: ...weeping may endure for a night,
fish.bot: but joy cometh in the morning.
fish.verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

fish.top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
fish.bot: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
fish.verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

fish.top: And he hath put a new song in my mouth,
fish.bot: even praise unto our God...
fish.verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD .

fish.top: Be still, and know that I am God:
fish.bot: I will be exalted among the heathen...
fish.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

fish.top: O send out thy light and thy truth:
fish.bot: let them lead me...
fish.verse: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

fish.top: God is our refuge and strength,
fish.bot: a very present help in trouble.
fish.verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

fish.top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
fish.bot: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
fish.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

fish.top: Cast thy burden upon the LORD,
fish.bot: and he shall sustain thee...
fish.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD , and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

fish.top: ...yea, in the shadow of thy wings
fish.bot: will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
fish.verse: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

fish.top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
fish.bot: my soul thirsteth for thee...
fish.verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

fish.top: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness;
fish.bot: and thy paths drop fatness.
fish.verse: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

fish.top: A father of the fatherless,
fish.bot: and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
fish.verse: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

fish.top: I will praise the name of God with a song,
fish.bot: and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
fish.verse: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

fish.top: My flesh and my heart faileth:
fish.bot: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
fish.verse: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

fish.top: But made his own people to go forth like sheep,
fish.bot: and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
fish.verse: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

fish.top: I am the LORD thy God...
fish.bot: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
fish.verse: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

fish.top: Wilt thou not revive us again:
fish.bot: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
fish.verse: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

fish.top: I will say of the LORD,
fish.bot: He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
fish.verse: I will say of the LORD , He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

fish.top: He that dwelleth in the secret place
fish.bot: of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
fish.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

fish.top: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us:
fish.bot: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us...
fish.verse: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

fish.top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
fish.bot: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
fish.verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

fish.top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
fish.bot: and into his courts with praise...
fish.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

fish.top: As far as the east is from the west,
fish.bot: so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
fish.verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

fish.top: For he satisfieth the longing soul,
fish.bot: and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
fish.verse: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

fish.top: He sent redemption unto his people:
fish.bot: he hath commanded his covenant for ever...
fish.verse: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

fish.top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
fish.bot: and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill...
fish.verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

fish.top: I will take the cup of salvation,
fish.bot: and call upon the name of the LORD.
fish.verse: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD .

fish.top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
fish.bot: and a light unto my path.
fish.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

fish.top: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills,
fish.bot: from whence cometh my help.
fish.verse: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

fish.top: They that sow in tears
fish.bot: shall reap in joy.
fish.verse: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

fish.top: But there is forgiveness with thee,
fish.bot: that thou mayest be feared.
fish.verse: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

fish.top: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is
fish.bot: for brethren to dwell together in unity!
fish.verse: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

fish.top: I will praise thee;
fish.bot: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...
fish.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

fish.top: Even there shall thy hand lead me,
fish.bot: and thy right hand shall hold me.
fish.verse: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

fish.top: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God:
fish.bot: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
fish.verse: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

fish.top: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him,
fish.bot: to all that call upon him in truth.
fish.verse: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

fish.top: Let every thing that hath breath
fish.bot: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
fish.verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .

fish.top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
fish.bot: and he shall direct thy paths.
fish.verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

fish.top: Blessed is the man that heareth me,
fish.bot: watching daily at my gates...
fish.verse: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

fish.top: Hatred stirreth up strifes:
fish.bot: but love covereth all sins.
fish.verse: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

fish.top: The liberal soul shall be made fat:
fish.bot: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
fish.verse: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

fish.top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
fish.bot: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
fish.verse: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

fish.top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
fish.bot: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
fish.verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

fish.top: Train up a child in the way he should go:
fish.bot: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
fish.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

fish.top: Iron sharpeneth iron;
fish.bot: so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
fish.verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

fish.top: Every word of God is pure:
fish.bot: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
fish.verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

fish.top: To every thing there is a season,
fish.bot: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
fish.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

fish.top: Two are better than one...
fish.bot: ...if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow...
fish.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

fish.top: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning...
fish.bot: ...the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
fish.verse: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

fish.top: Remember now thy Creator
fish.bot: in the days of thy youth...
fish.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

fish.top: He brought me to the banqueting house,
fish.bot: and his banner over me was love.
fish.verse: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

fish.top: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine:
fish.bot: he feedeth among the lilies.
fish.verse: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

fish.top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
fish.bot: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...
fish.verse: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD : though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

fish.top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
fish.bot: Then said I, Here am I; send me.
fish.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

fish.top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
fish.bot: and shall call his name Immanuel.
fish.verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

fish.top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
fish.bot: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
fish.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

fish.top: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
fish.bot: out of the wells of salvation.
fish.verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

fish.top: At that day shall a man look to his Maker,
fish.bot: and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
fish.verse: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

fish.top: And the key of the house of David...
fish.bot: ...so he shall open, and none shall shut...
fish.verse: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

fish.top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
fish.bot: whose mind is stayed on thee...
fish.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

fish.top: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone,
fish.bot: a tried stone, a precious corner stone...
fish.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

fish.top: In returning and rest shall ye be saved;
fish.bot: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength...
fish.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

fish.top: ...as rivers of water in a dry place,
fish.bot: as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
fish.verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

fish.top: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return,
fish.bot: and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy...
fish.verse: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

fish.top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
fish.bot: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...
fish.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

fish.top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
fish.bot: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
fish.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

fish.top: And even to your old age I am he;
fish.bot: and even to hoar hairs will I carry you...
fish.verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you .

fish.top: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
fish.bot: of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace...
fish.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

fish.top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
fish.bot: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
fish.verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

fish.top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
fish.bot: ...and with his stripes we are healed.
fish.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

fish.top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
fish.bot: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
fish.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

fish.top: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory
fish.bot: in the hand of the LORD...
fish.verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

fish.top: ...they have forsaken me
fish.bot: the fountain of living waters...
fish.verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

fish.top: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way,
fish.bot: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.
fish.verse: Thus saith the LORD , Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein .

fish.top: Obey my voice, and I will be your God,
fish.bot: and ye shall be my people...
fish.verse: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

fish.top: ...let him that glorieth glory in this,
fish.bot: that he understandeth and knoweth me...
fish.verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD .

fish.top: ...yet thou, O LORD
fish.bot: art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name...
fish.verse: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD , art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

fish.top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
fish.bot: so are ye in mine hand...
fish.verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD . Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

fish.top: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters,
fish.bot: and that spreadeth out her roots by the river...
fish.verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

fish.top: ...I will raise unto David a righteous Branch,
fish.bot: and a King shall reign and prosper...
fish.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

fish.top: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings,
fish.bot: and obey the voice of the LORD your God...
fish.verse: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

fish.top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
fish.bot: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
fish.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

fish.top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
fish.bot: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.
fish.verse: Ah Lord GOD ! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

fish.top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
fish.bot: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
fish.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

fish.top: For I will surely deliver thee...
fish.bot: ...because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
fish.verse: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD .

fish.top: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down,
fish.bot: and I will plant you, and not pluck you up...
fish.verse: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

fish.top: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD:
fish.bot: for I am with thee...
fish.verse: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD : for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

fish.top: ...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for,
fish.bot: and there shall be none... for I will pardon them...
fish.verse: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

fish.top: ...his compassions fail not.
fish.bot: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
fish.verse: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

fish.top: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul;
fish.bot: therefore will I hope in him.
fish.verse: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

fish.top: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever;
fish.bot: thy throne from generation to generation.
fish.verse: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

fish.top: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman
fish.bot: ...therefore hear the word at my mouth...
fish.verse: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

fish.top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
fish.bot: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...
fish.verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

fish.top: ...and the house was filled with the cloud,
fish.bot: ...full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
fish.verse: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

fish.top: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant...
fish.bot: ...and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
fish.verse: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

fish.top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
fish.bot: ...wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
fish.verse: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye.

fish.top: Repent, and turn yourselves...
fish.bot: ...so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
fish.verse: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD . Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

fish.top: And I sought for a man among them,
fish.bot: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...
fish.verse: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

fish.top: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards;
fish.bot: yea, they shall dwell with confidence...
fish.verse: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

fish.top: None of his sins that he hath committed
fish.bot: shall be mentioned unto him...he shall surely live.
fish.verse: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

fish.top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
fish.bot: and seek them out.
fish.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

fish.top: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,
fish.bot: and I shall place you in your own land...
fish.verse: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it , and performed it , saith the LORD .

fish.top: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters:
fish.bot: and the earth shined with his glory.
fish.verse: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

fish.top: And they shall teach my people
fish.bot: the difference between the holy and profane...
fish.verse: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

fish.top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
fish.bot: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...
fish.verse: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

fish.top: But Daniel purposed in his heart
fish.bot: that he would not defile himself...
fish.verse: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

fish.top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
fish.bot: forasmuch as he was faithful...
fish.verse: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

fish.top: O man greatly beloved, fear not:
fish.bot: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong.
fish.verse: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

fish.top: ...they that turn many to righteousness
fish.bot: as the stars for ever and ever.
fish.verse: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

fish.top: ...if we follow on to know the LORD:
fish.bot: his going forth is prepared as the morning...
fish.verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD : his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

fish.top: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice;
fish.bot: and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
fish.verse: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

fish.top: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy;
fish.bot: ...for it is time to seek the LORD...
fish.verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD , till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

fish.top: I will be as the dew unto Israel:
fish.bot: he shall grow as the lily...
fish.verse: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

fish.top: And I will restore to you
fish.bot: the years that the locust hath eaten...
fish.verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

fish.top: But let judgment run down as waters,
fish.bot: and righteousness as a mighty stream.
fish.verse: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

fish.top: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David
fish.bot: that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof...
fish.verse: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

fish.top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
fish.bot: to swallow up Jonah.
fish.verse: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

fish.top: I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD,
fish.bot: and he heard me...thou heardest my voice.
fish.verse: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD , and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

fish.top: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city,
fish.bot: wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons...
fish.verse: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

fish.top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
fish.bot: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
fish.verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

fish.top: The LORD is good, a strong hold
fish.bot: in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
fish.verse: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

fish.top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
fish.bot: that he may run that readeth it.
fish.verse: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

fish.top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
fish.bot: he will rejoice over thee with joy...
fish.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

fish.top: ...will be unto her a wall of fire round about,
fish.bot: and will be the glory in the midst of her.
fish.verse: For I, saith the LORD , will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

fish.top: ...I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee,
fish.bot: and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
fish.verse: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

fish.top: Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour;
fish.bot: execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates...
fish.verse: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

fish.top: ...behold, thy King cometh unto thee:
fish.bot: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...
fish.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

fish.top: In that day there shall be a fountain opened
fish.bot: ...for sin and for uncleanness.
fish.verse: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

fish.top: ...thou shalt call his name JESUS:
fish.bot: for he shall save his people from their sins.
fish.verse: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

fish.top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
fish.bot: and I will make you fishers of men.
fish.verse: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

fish.top: Let your light so shine before men,
fish.bot: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...
fish.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

fish.top: Give us this day
fish.bot: our daily bread.
fish.verse: Give us this day our daily bread.

fish.top: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me;
fish.bot: ...and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
fish.verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

fish.top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
fish.bot: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
fish.verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

fish.top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
fish.bot: ...nothing shall be impossible unto you.
fish.verse: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

fish.top: Hosanna to the Son of David:
fish.bot: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord...
fish.verse: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

fish.top: Well done, thou good and faithful servant:
fish.bot: ...enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
fish.verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

fish.top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
fish.bot: baptizing them in the name of the Father...
fish.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

fish.top: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.
fish.bot: Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
fish.verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

fish.top: ...and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.
fish.bot: And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
fish.verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

fish.top: If thou canst believe,
fish.bot: all things are possible to him that believeth.
fish.verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

fish.top: Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee;
fish.bot: ...nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
fish.verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

fish.top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
fish.bot: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
fish.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

fish.top: Launch out into the deep,
fish.bot: and let down your nets for a draught.
fish.verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

fish.top: If any man will come after me,
fish.bot: let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily...
fish.verse: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

fish.top: The harvest truly is great,
fish.bot: but the labourers are few...
fish.verse: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

fish.top: For where your treasure is,
fish.bot: there will your heart be also.
fish.verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

fish.top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
fish.bot: he was lost, and is found.
fish.verse: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

fish.top: For the Son of man is come
fish.bot: to seek and to save that which was lost.
fish.verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

fish.top: ...Behold the Lamb of God,
fish.bot: which taketh away the sin of the world.
fish.verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

fish.top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
fish.bot: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
fish.verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

fish.top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
fish.bot: ye shall be free indeed.
fish.verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

fish.top: ...one thing I know,
fish.bot: that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
fish.verse: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

fish.top: I am the resurrection, and the life:
fish.bot: he that believeth in me... yet shall he live:
fish.verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

fish.top: Abide in me, and I in you.
fish.bot: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...
fish.verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

fish.top: ...he said, It is finished:
fish.bot: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
fish.verse: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

fish.top: But ye shall receive power,
fish.bot: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...
fish.verse: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

fish.top: ...there is none other name under heaven
